name: dev-kit
description: Author issues, publish them to GitHub, implement, test, review, and deliver software changes with explicit quality gates.

interface.shortDescription: A guarded pipeline from issues through draft pull requests.
interface.longDescription: Turn technical input into self-contained GitHub Issues, implement the full scope with test-driven development, review through a read-only subagent, and deliver a draft pull request. Compose spans such as develop -> git or to-issues -> git.
defaultPrompt: Turn this specification into GitHub Issues and deliver them.
Run develop -> git for this GitHub Issue.
Grill every doubt before turning this RFC into issues.
Review this pull request against its requirements.
